About Me

Marketing that starts with understanding people

Growing up around two family-run retail businesses in Rewa, I didn't learn marketing from a textbook — I learned it from watching real customers walk in, browse, and either buy or leave. That taught me something most courses miss: people don't buy products, they buy feelings of trust.

That curiosity pulled me into digital marketing. I got obsessed with why some reels go viral while identical ones die at 200 views. Why some captions make you stop scrolling. Why some brands feel premium even with zero budget. I started testing, growing real pages, running real campaigns — and I haven't stopped since.

Today I combine audience psychology, content strategy, and AI-assisted workflows to help brands grow organically. I think in hooks, angles, and outcomes — and I bring ideas to the table, not just tasks. Specialized in Email Marketing and LinkedIn Marketing, with hands-on campaign experience driving real results.

Case Study

How I Would Grow a
D2C Brand Organically

A real strategic exercise — how I'd take a new D2C brand from 0 to traction using zero paid ads, just content, psychology, and platform mechanics.

01 · The Problem

Brand exists. Nobody knows it yet.

A new women's fashion D2C brand has great products but zero social presence, zero trust, and zero content. They can't afford ads. Every post gets 12 likes — all from family.

02 · Target Audience

Women 18–35, value-driven buyers

They scroll Instagram for 45+ min/day. They buy based on trust signals — reviews, real people wearing it, DM responses, and how the brand talks to them. Price matters, but vibe matters more.

03 · Content Strategy

3-pillar content system

Trust content (40%) — customer unboxings, "day in the life with our product," founder story reels.
Desire content (40%) — styled looks, "outfit of the day," trending audio + product drops.
Conversion content (20%) — price reveals, limited stock alerts, DM CTA hooks.

04 · Reel Strategy

Hook → Story → CTA in 15 sec

Every reel opens with a pattern interrupt (unexpected visual or text), builds desire in the middle (product worn naturally, not modelled stiffly), and ends with a soft CTA ("Link in bio / DM us 💬"). Trending audio layered on top for algorithm push.

05 · Engagement Engine

Build community, not just followers

Reply to every comment in the first 30 min (signals the algorithm). Run weekly polls/questions in Stories. Feature real customers in posts. Create a "tribe" feeling — followers become brand advocates who tag friends organically.

06 · Expected Result

0 to traction in 60 days

With consistent execution: 500–1,500 organic followers in 60 days, 1–3 viral reels (10K+ views), 15–30% DM conversion rate from interested followers, and a brand that feels established even at 1,000 followers.

✕
Thinking Out Loud

Marketing Experiments & Ideas

Things I study, test, and observe. This is what separates someone who knows marketing from someone who thinks marketing.

🎣 Hook Analysis

Viral Hook Patterns on Instagram

Studied 50+ viral reels and found 3 hook patterns that consistently stop the scroll: Shock opening ("Nobody talks about this…"), Curiosity gap ("I tried X for 30 days…"), and Relatability trigger ("Every small business owner needs to see this"). Hooks decide 90% of a reel's reach before the content even plays.

📈 Growth Strategy

Local Business Instagram Growth Playbook

For jewellers and cloth stores, I found that price reveal reels ("₹500 saree — see quality") outperform product showcase posts 3x. Local audiences respond to value proof over aesthetics. Combined with rate updates and customer reaction clips, this builds a trust loop that drives walk-ins without ads.

🧠 Audience Psychology

Why People Follow Local Brands

People don't follow local businesses for content — they follow for confidence. A verified badge, a consistent posting schedule, and customer testimonials signal legitimacy. The real conversion isn't a like or a share — it's someone thinking "I trust this enough to visit." Every post should build that trust, not just show the product.

🤖 AI Workflows

How I Use AI to Produce Content 3x Faster

My workflow: ChatGPT for caption angles + hashtag research → Canva for visuals → CapCut for reel editing. The key insight: AI drafts, humans refine. AI gives me 10 caption options in 30 seconds; I pick the one that sounds human and brand-aligned. This cuts ideation time by ~70% without losing authenticity.

📊 Brand Breakdown

What Schola Classes Was Missing

When I joined, their content was announcement-heavy ("New batch starts Monday!"). Students don't care about announcements — they care about outcomes and belonging. I proposed shifting to student success stories, behind-the-scenes teaching clips, and aspirational messaging. Posts that make a student think: "That could be me."

🎯 Reel Strategy

The 3-Second Rule for Short-Form Video

Instagram's algorithm decides in the first 3 seconds whether to push a reel. This means the visual opening frame matters more than the entire rest of the video. I structure every reel: bold text overlay in frame 1, movement or colour contrast by second 2, payoff teased by second 3. The middle can be average — the start cannot.
